final: WITH group_stats AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc >= 4.86 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile) SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS avg_of_group_bandusage_averages, AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_group_telescope_count FROM group_stats
